meta.name: Sync GitHub Markdown docs with StudioCMS pages and taxonomy

name: Sync a GitHub Markdown knowledge base to StudioCMS

parameters.content:
## Sync a GitHub Markdown knowledge base to StudioCMS

### How it works

This workflow manually deploys a GitHub-based Markdown or MDX knowledge base into StudioCMS. It lists and filters source files, parses their frontmatter, validates the collection, then compares the content against existing StudioCMS folders, categories, tags, and pages. It creates any missing taxonomy first, refreshes StudioCMS state, then creates, updates, drafts, skips, or records validation errors for pages before producing a deployment summary.

### Setup steps

- Configure GitHub credentials with access to the repository that contains the Markdown or MDX knowledge base.
- Configure StudioCMS credentials for the target site or workspace where folders, categories, tags, and pages will be synchronized.
- Update the content source settings for githubOwner, githubRepository, sourcePath, and draftMissingPages in the configuration node.
- Verify the Markdown frontmatter fields expected by the parsing and validation code match the schema required by StudioCMS pages and taxonomy.

### Customization

Adjust the source path, file extensions, frontmatter mapping, validation rules, and the draftMissingPages behavior to fit the structure of your knowledge base and StudioCMS publishing policy.

## Start content deployment

Provides the manual entry point and sets the GitHub repository, source path, and deployment options used by the rest of the workflow.

## Discover source files

Lists the configured GitHub directory, keeps only Markdown and MDX files, and branches based on whether deployable content was found.

## Report empty source

Ends the workflow with a clear report when the configured GitHub directory contains no Markdown or MDX content to deploy.

## Parse and validate content

Fetches each Markdown file from GitHub, extracts frontmatter and body content, and validates the full collection before syncing it to StudioCMS.

## Fetch taxonomy state

Retrieves existing StudioCMS folders, categories, and tags so the workflow can determine which taxonomy records are missing.

## Plan taxonomy changes

Gets the current StudioCMS pages and plans the missing folders, categories, and tags required by the validated Markdown collection.

## Create missing taxonomy

Processes taxonomy changes one at a time, routing each item to create a missing folder, category, or tag, or to continue when no taxonomy work is needed.

## Refresh taxonomy lists

Reloads StudioCMS folders, categories, and tags after creation so page deployment uses the latest taxonomy IDs and relationships.

## Plan page deployment

Compares validated source content with current StudioCMS pages, decides which pages need creation, update, drafting, skipping, or error retention, and starts batch processing those actions.

## Route page actions

Branches each planned page deployment item to the correct action path for creation, update, draft marking, skipping, or validation error handling.

## Apply page writes

Performs the StudioCMS write operations for pages that need to be created, updated, or marked as draft because they are missing from the source.

## Pass through outcomes

Carries forward page actions that do not require a StudioCMS write, including unchanged pages and validation errors that should be preserved in the results.

## Format deployment summary

Normalizes each page deployment result for the batch loop and produces the final StudioCMS deployment summary after all page actions finish.
